column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-dev-shows-v2 - TV show parent records plus independently mutable show-watcher child rows. Parent ids remain the feed module id; watcher ids use show-watcher#<parentId>#<userId>, so each watcher has its own row. membersStorage is rows for current parents; watcherRowsMigratedAt appears only on parents converted from the former embedded members list. Season and episode are 1-based; watchparty fields are present only while live. Keyed (groupId HASH, id RANGE): the group is the partition, so no row can be addressed from another household.
